name: CG Mukashi Banashi - Jiisan 2 do Bikkuri!!
original_name: CG昔話 じいさん2度びっくり！！
source:
CG Mukashi Banashi - Jiisan 2 do Bikkuri!! features 3 different fairy tales with the options for the player like in most of the visual novels, in parts of the story of choose between different possibilities that will leave the story in a way or another, the game as usual in his kind features different endings depending of those choices.

[From [url=https://psxdatacenter.com/games/J/C/SLPS-00230.html]psxdatacenter[/url]]
translation:
CG Mukashi Banashi - Jiisan 2 do Bikkuri!!像大多数视觉小说一样，有3个不同的童话故事，玩家可以选择，在故事的某些部分，可以在不同的可能性之间进行选择，从而以某种方式离开故事，游戏像往常一样，根据这些选择提供不同的结局。

[来自[url=https://psxdatacenter.com/games/J/C/SLPS-00230.html]psxdatacenter[/url]]
